name: Legacy: Top Models

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT model, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM (
  SELECT TraceId, arrayJoin(Models) AS model
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
    AND TotalDurationMs > 0
)
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 10
